entities.summary: Pablo Nicolás Matera is an Argentine professional rugby union player who plays as a flanker for Japan Rugby League One club Mie Honda Heat and the Argentina national team. He is regarded as one of the best rugby players in the world and became Argentina's most capped player ever in 2025.
